fidelity: F2a — AMR cycle with mean-field (Weiss/Brillouin) Gd magnetocaloric material
source: Pecharsky & Gschneidner (1999) JMMM 200:44; Dan'kov et al. (1998) PRB 57:3478; Tishin & Spichkin (2003) The Magnetocaloric Effect and its Applications, IOP; Kitanovski et al. (2015) Magnetocaloric Energy Conversion, Springer

J_total.note: Total angular momentum of Gd3+ (4f7, S=7/2, L=0), J=7/2 (Tishin & Spichkin 2003)

T_Curie_K.note: Gd Curie temperature ~293 K (Dan'kov et al. 1998; Pecharsky & Gschneidner 1999)

cp_solid.note: Gd specific heat near T_C (Dan'kov et al. 1998; ~280 J/kgK peak, 235 baseline)

debye_temp_K.note: Debye temperature of Gd (lattice entropy, Tishin & Spichkin 2003)

B_field_max.note: Permanent-magnet applied flux density (Kitanovski et al. 2015)

a_specific.note: Specific surface area of packed Gd spheres (~0.5 mm)

eta_magnet.note: Magnet/drive system efficiency: real cycle work = ideal M-H loop work / eta_magnet, accounts for eddy currents, demag-field & drive losses (Kitanovski et al. 2015)

T_cold_K.note: Cold reservoir temperature (5 K span centred on T_C=293 K, below AMR no-load span)
